# Athelstan (WWAIJD)

> Athelstan is a free, non-denominational AI-powered Bible study platform. Named for a doctorate-level scripture scholar inspired by Æthelstan (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%86thelstan)—patron of learning—it provides scripture-grounded answers to life questions, interactive Bible passage reading, daily devotionals, community prayer support, and topical scripture guides.

## Overview & Core Capabilities

- [Ask Athelstan](https://wwaijd.org/): Interactive Bible Q&A assistant retrieving relevant verses (RAG pipeline) with scholarly, scripture-grounded guidance.
- [Read Holy Bible](https://wwaijd.org/bible): Full online access to Old Testament and New Testament scripture across multiple translations (KJV, BSB, WEB, etc.).
- [Daily Devotional](https://wwaijd.org/devotional): Daily Verse of the Day with a reflection, guided prayer, and daily reading streak tracker.
- [Community Prayer Wall](https://wwaijd.org/prayers): Anonymous community prayer requests wall where users can request and offer prayers.
- [Spiritual Study Plans](https://wwaijd.org/plans): Multi-day guided reading modules focusing on hope, peace, faith, and spiritual growth.
- [Bible Topics Index](https://wwaijd.org/topics): Categorized index of Bible verses organized by life themes (forgiveness, anxiety, relationships, hope, faith, etc.).
- [Community Questions Archive](https://wwaijd.org/questions): Index of real spiritual questions answered with biblical references.

## Key Resources & Links

- Full AI Context File: [llms-full.txt](https://wwaijd.org/llms-full.txt)

## Primary Topics Covered

- [Forgiveness](https://wwaijd.org/topics/forgiveness): Bible verses on mercy, releasing bitterness, and divine grace.
- [Hope](https://wwaijd.org/topics/hope): Scripture on perseverance, trust in God, and strength through trials.
- [Relationships](https://wwaijd.org/topics/relationships): Guidance on love, conflict resolution, family, and fellowship.
- [Peace & Anxiety](https://wwaijd.org/topics/peace): Verses for overcoming fear, worry, and finding inner quietness in God.
- [Faith & Purpose](https://wwaijd.org/topics/faith): Scripture on discovering God's plan and walking in faith.
